style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Pre Lit Christmas Joy Bough
style.toneOfVoice: Easily add depth and texture to your Christmas décor. The Pre Lit Christmas Joy Bough adds a luxe look to your home interior. A gorgeous spray of faux pines, leaves and berries in rich tones of burgundy and green are gathered on a twig base, and held in place with a hessian twine. Pinecones, and warm white LEDs are dotted throughout, and a large velvet bow is set up top for a truly luxurious seasonal note. Complete with a handy hook at the top, styling couldn’t be easier – this bough looks incredibly beautiful placed on a door or on the kitchen wall. To illuminate, simply insert 2 x AA batteries into the attached battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the optional 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Pair your bough with the matching "Christmas Joy" foliage range to take your styling to the next level.
